decisions: telescoping boarding boom because only the 3 m Dock_Primary corridor reaches past the 45 m shield and 30 m rings
stroke 25 m = [station].undock_standoff_m: undocking is the boom retracting; the ship never thrusts toward the station at close range
station body beyond r 50 m (shield + 5 m): no ship part can reach it, docked or retracted
umbilical (power, data, water, N2/O2, bonding) along the boom; no propellant through the crew port
EVA inspection hoop with two foot-restraint sockets at the adapter; work platform on the hub aft side away from the shield rim
open: docking, capture, station-keeping and boom bending loads
sliding seal wear and dynamic loads

ship radial translation authority and plume rules for separation
